csv_project_name: Study for Hwy 55 Golden Valley Reconnecting Communities
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Minnesota , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to Provide Study for State is carrying out a transportation corridor planning study for TH 55 from Drive in the City of Medina to the eastern border of the City of Golden Valley (approximately 14 miles). This study is part of MnDOT s federally awarded Reconnecting Communities grant and will develop a vision to enhance safety, connectivity, and accessibility for all users along and across the corridor. The study will coordinate with local partners including Metro Transit, Hennepin County, the Metropolitan Council, the Three Rivers Park District, and the cities of Golden Valley, Plymouth and Medina. The corridor is expected to receive several investments over the next decade, including a planned resurfacing project identified in the Metro Capital Highway Improvement Plan (CHIP) from Fernbrook Lane to Wright/Hennepin County Line and the anticipated 757 Route developed as part of Metro Transit s recent TH 55 Transit study.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Public Transit Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies
